content_sections.heading: KUDSIT Job Description
content_sections.text: AI Engineer Understand, design, and develop AI and Computer Vision solutions. Develop prototypes, pilot systems, and complete solutions. Review technical and functional specifications. Publish research papers and prepare detailed reports based on the studies conducted, write project proposals. Coordinate and conduct data collection and labeling activities. Project Scientist Understand, design, and develop AI solutions and NLP problems especially palm leaf transliteration. Development of prototypes, pilot systems, and complete solutions. Review technical and functional specifications. Publish research papers, prepare detailed reports based on the studies conducted and write project proposals. Conduct visits and collaborate with related organizations for data collection and annotation. Coordinate and conduct data collection and labeling activities.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: M.Tech/ME/MCA/M.Sc/MPhil in Computer Science from a recognized University with good academic performance and research experience. Age limit: Maximum 30 years. Pay: Rs.25,000 consolidated per month. Qualification required: Ph.D. in Computer Science with specialization in AI or allied areas; M.Tech/ME/MCA/M.Sc/MPhil in Computer Science or allied areas from a recognized University/Educational Institution with a good academic record and research experience. Experience required: Minimum 3 years of working experience in NLP/AI/Machine Learning at a reputed institution, with a proven record of research publications (research experience during Ph.D period also considered). Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: Rs.45,000 for postgraduation with relevant experience; Rs.50,000 for Ph.D with relevant experience.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: AI Engineer: initially four months, extendable up to one year on contract, subject to feasibility study results. Project Scientist: initially four months on contract, extendable subject to performance.

content_sections.heading: How Will KUDSIT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Test Interview Selection will be based on a test and interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KUDSIT Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Submit the application online by 06-11-2026. The application form is available at https://www.duk.ac.in/careers. Upload scanned copies of documents proving age, qualification and experience with the online application. Produce originals when called for. Schedule of the test/interview will be sent only to the registered email, so check it regularly after the last date.
